option_relations.rationale: The option directly matches the leaf label for Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome.
Gastric outlet obstruction is a symptom or condition, not directly related to the specific diagnosis of Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome.
Peptic stricture of the stomach is a different condition and not directly related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome.
Neoplasm of the stomach is a different condition and not directly related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome.
The listed conditions are alternative causes and not directly related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome.
Peptic ulcer disease and duodenal tumors are different conditions and not directly related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome.
Scleroderma and other collagen or vascular disorders are different conditions and not directly related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome.
Vascular compression due to a reduced aortomesenteric angle is a mechanism related to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome.
